description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Stunning Home:* Private Pool and Hot Tub! * LSV Golf Cart (add'l fee$75/night)* 4 Free Bikes included* Newly Enhanced* 8 beach access points within a one-mile radius* Corn hole, outdoor table tennis, pool table, and air hockey table* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions. *We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates Snowbird Season runs from January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to Saltaire, a luxurious custom-designed retreat perfect for your next family escape. Nestled on a private drive just off 30A, this stunning home offers an ideal blend of seclusion and convenience. It's just a short stroll (528 yards) or bike ride to Seagrove's top shops and restaurants and a quick ride to the charm of Seaside. While the sugar-white sands are accessible from eight nearby beach access points within a one-mile radius, why walk when you can explore the area in style with four bikes or the included six-seater golf cart (add'l fee $75/night).The grand entry sets the tone, inviting you into this stately home with an air of sophistication. Dual sliding doors along the walkway create a seamless blend of indoor and outdoor living. Step out to the expansive reclaimed coral patio, where a massive outdoor hearth provides a cozy gathering space for cool evenings. Unwind in the custom-designed saltwater pool with nightly pool heating available for $45/nt, relax in the jetted spa, or soak up the sun on loungers under a shady umbrella. The outdoor grill is perfect for preparing delicious meals, and the patio features fun amenities like a corn hole setup and a ping-pong table for friendly competition.Inside, the chef’s kitchen is a culinary dream, featuring a 36-inch, six-burner Bertazzoni range and a custom pecky cypress range hood. The large dining table is perfect for shared meals, while bar seating for six adds a casual dining option. The family room is a hub for relaxation and entertainment, offering a plush sectional, two cozy lounge chairs, a 55-inch flat-screen TV, and a full-sized pool table.The home’s accommodations ensure ultimate comfort for up to 14 guests. The primary bedroom on the main floor features a King bed with a Twin daybed with Twin Trundle and a luxurious ensuite bathroom, complete with a soaking tub and an oversized walk-in shower. Two additional guest rooms on the main floor each offer King beds, while the second floor is perfect for younger guests with a spacious bunk room featuring two Twin-over-Queen built-in bunks and an air hockey table for added fun.And if you're looking for space for up to 4 more guests, please contact us to book the additional guest house that accommodates an additional 4 guests!Bed Setup:1st Floor Master Bedroom: King Bed and Twin Day Bed w/ Twin TrundleGuest Bedroom #1: King BedGuest Bedroom #2: King Bed2nd Floor Guest Bedroom #3: 2 Twin over Queen BunkbedsArea Attractions: Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It's incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
